item.title: Life as Animator Joe
item.author: Author
item.description: I am not just a developer, but also an animator. I make stop motion animations with legos and post them under my YouTube channel Animator Joe. Be warn, the channel is NSFW. The channel started when I was in middle school, when I decided to make a lego music video for the song Dumb Ways to Die. The video was a hit! Reaching 100k views in a few months when my channel had only 5 subscribers.
